newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia raises internal coffee price again.
newsitem.headline: Colombia raises internal coffee price again.

text.p: Colombia's National Coffee Growers' Federation raised the country's internal coffee price by 0.84 percent to 345,625 pesos per 125-kg load in the ninth such price hike since Jan. 31, a federation spokesman said.
The new price, up from 342,750 pesos set on April 11, was based on an average price of $2.05 per pound for Colombian coffee in New York, the spokesman said.

The internal price, which is set every Friday, has been cut only twice since the end of January, when the federation introduced a new sliding scale formula to calculate it and bring it closer into line with world market prices.

In other developments, the federation also announced that it had sold all 300,000 70-kg bags of old crop coffee that it offered to private exporters on March 7 to help cover possible shortfalls in May/June shipments.
Jorge Cardenas, the federation's veteran leader, said Monday that Colombia's coffee inventories had dropped to 5 million 60-kg bags from 6.5 million bags in October.
